for f in lib/data.ts next.config.ts app/product/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx; do echo "== $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -ril "instant" . | head -30; grep -rn "unstable_instant\|export const instant" . | head -20
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; cat 02-guides/instant-navigation.md | head -250; echo ======; cat 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config/instant.md
